limits: Visual review is limited to these six retained hosted Windows captures at 96 DPI.
Intentional scroll-pane and DAG viewport clipping and list-cell ellipses are distinguished from fixed-control overlap.
This review does not establish high-DPI, multi-monitor, physical-trackpad or representative-PC acceptance.
Images alone do not establish functional behavior; native assertions remain in the separately retained updater and curated reports.

publicationAcceptance.reason: The 7a9aca7 target subsequently failed the full disabled-policy long-path release gate because additional pack self-check nesting created a 291-character native working directory. These successful scoped updater/UI results apply only to that old target and do not validate the corrected a447997 candidate.
